title: Preview selected fields in an authorized inventory-aging report
description: An inventory user selects finite existing stock-aging fields and warehouse/product/as-of-date filters for a bounded read-only preview. Reuse ERP-034 inventory-aging report service, including authoritative FIFO age buckets, separate unknown-age and unknown-cost evidence, persisted cost currency, and stock-query menu authorization; do not widen data scope or compute new valuation. Unknown cost amounts remain null rather than zero. Invalid requests fail closed before report reads; HTTP audit records read-only requests. Development only: no Domain/schema change, migration, production SQL, real database execution, arbitrary model SQL, writes, secret/.env change or deployment. Verify unit tests and safe build/test.
acceptance_criteria: Authenticated catalog exposes a finite allowlist of existing scalar and fixed age-bucket fields; preview rejects unknown columns, malformed date/warehouse/product filters and page size above 200 before reading.

Preview requires the current user's stock-query menu and reuses existing inventory-aging service for bounded warehouse/product/as-of-date paging; selected columns preserve unknown-age, unknown-cost and CNY cost semantics without writes.
Tests cover allowed/denied users, bucket boundaries, selected field order, unknown amounts, filters, page cap and no writes; document aging and valuation evidence limits.
